intro.text: A mansion in Bilming, home of the city's sitting lord mayor.

description.text: Though far from the tallest building in Bilming, its styling and silvery-white paint lend it majesty. It has a springy lawn.

items.text: In 348 PC it was home to Mayor Gave Entrone, who also owned a mansion at the edge of town.

Suspecting Gave, Wax and Wayne travelled to the city and forced their way into his office in the house. Wax found a calendar mentioning a "lab", an unusual safe, and a trapdoor to a small bunker with a storm-drain exit. Wayne's diversionary fire got out of hand, and the house burned.
The Set had not expected the break-in, and what Wax learned there helped him work out Gave's real aims.
